title: Production Grammar & Editable Media
authority_chain: EntityGraph -> ShotReadiness -> VisualBeat/MotionPlan -> Renderer -> Candidate -> P5.1 -> EditableBackend -> Delivery

mypy_baseline_errors: hevi/production/gpu_compute.py:206: error: Returning Any from function declared to return "dict[str, Any] | None"  [no-any-return]

tts.unavailable_reason: pocket-tts runtime not installed; model weights are not vendored by HEVI

blockers.scope: P5.1 native video review and P5.1+P5.2 full integration
blockers.evidence: fal.ai returns 403 {"detail":"User is locked. Reason: TOP_UP."}
blockers.unblocks: top up fal.ai, or supply any other real native-video provider credential (DashScope, TeamoRouter, OpenCode gateway, NVIDIA NIM, OpenAI and local Ollama were each tested and rejected in P5.1)

blockers.evidence: torch.cuda.is_available() is False; nvidia-smi reports an unknown device handle; ComfyUI is not running and its venv interpreter is missing
blockers.unblocks: restore the GPU, or restore ComfyUI. EchoMimicV2 weights (5.9 GB) are already on disk, so this is a runtime problem, not a missing model.

blockers.evidence: the pocket-tts runtime is not installed and its weights are not vendored by HEVI
blockers.unblocks: install the runtime, or leave it. Declared English-only either way: CHINESE_TTS=UNSUPPORTED and SILENT_LANGUAGE_FALLBACK=0 are asserted in the architecture suite so adoption can never quietly enable a silent Chinese fallback.

p51_integration.reason: P5.1 native review needs fal.ai, which is locked for credit. P5.2 core is qualified independently and does not depend on it.

resolved.was: P5.1's layered draft refused an element with no source path, so a parametric text overlay reached CapCut and was silently dropped by the internal backend. The differential reported the divergence, which meant the cut was not eligible for dual-backend delivery.
resolved.now: PARAMETRIC_TEXT_OVERLAY_INTERNAL=PASS, PARAMETRIC_TEXT_OVERLAY_CAPCUT=PASS, CROSS_BACKEND_SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENCE=PASS, TEXT_CONTENT_PRESERVED=YES, START_END_PRESERVED=YES, POSITION_PRESERVED=YES, STYLE_FIELDS_PRESERVED_WHERE_SUPPORTED=YES, UNSUPPORTED_STYLE_EXPLICIT=YES, SILENT_FLATTENING=0, SILENT_DROP=0
resolved.change: P5.1 learned to express a parametric text element as a real text material whose copy lives in a real sidecar file, and to carry the element's own position, opacity and scale into the segment instead of writing every element at the origin. P5.2 introduced one canonical field vocabulary that each backend declares support for, and the differential now compares those declarations, so a style field one editor can honour and another cannot is reported as a CAPABILITY_DIVERGENCE rather than dropped.
resolved.authorised_p51_delta: hevi/ops/p5_1_editable.py only, pinned by symbol in tests/test_p5_2_architecture.py. hevi/ops/p5_1_types.py is unchanged: the shared type vocabulary did not grow.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: click detection compared window peaks in the source, which cannot detect anything: a cut inside a continuous waveform is continuous by definition, and ffmpeg resampling shifts phase enough to invent or hide a step
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: measure the discontinuity in the rendered file at each join, with a window that tolerates codec delay and a threshold relative to the track's own peak

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: edit points were formatted to three decimals, quantising away the phase that decides whether a join clicks
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: six decimals plus -accurate_seek, so a planned join lands where it was planned

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: a protocol-relative URL (//evil.example/x.js) has no scheme and passed a scheme deny-list, so a network reference was allowed
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: allow-list semantics: only an explicitly recognised scheme passes

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: the report declared file and shell attempt arrays that nothing ever populated, so 'clean' was indistinguishable from a page that never tried to leave the sandbox
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the capture now probes the sandbox from inside the page and records each attempt and refusal; clean means nothing escaped, and probed says whether the verdict is earned

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: a back-to-back Chromium launch race produced CAPTURE_FAILED with an empty reason, which reads as a content bug
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: one bounded retry, the attempt count reported, and a reason that states exit status, frame count and captured output

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: the capability-claim pattern matched only marketing phrasing, so the strongest claims -- 'verified', 'release qualified', 'production ready' -- went unexamined and could borrow support from an unrelated screenshot
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: a second pattern for verification and qualification language, checked against 8 positive and negative cases

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Path('') is the current directory and always exists, so an element with no source artifact passed the existence check and was emitted as path: '' — the CLI then rejected the project
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: an explicit empty-source test, and a parametric element with real text is routed to CapCut's text track instead of being dropped

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: layer_coverage and semantic_roles were derived from the input manifest rather than from the project written, so the projection claimed layers it had silently dropped and the differential could not see a backend losing an element
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: coverage is read back from the draft and P5.1's refused_elements are surfaced, so the differential reports the divergence

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: every element was required to have a source artifact, which makes a parametric text overlay inexpressible and pushes overlays toward flattened images — the opposite of an editable project
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: a parametric element is accepted when it actually declares the properties it is built from

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: provider_capability and source_video were never set, so a plan built from a qualified presenter source recorded itself as AVATAR_GENERATION — a provenance claim about work never done
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: capability, background policy and lip-sync policy are derived from what was actually supplied

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: entrance and exit shared the MOTION justification family, so one justification for a camera move silently excused a repeated entrance effect
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: ENTRANCE and EXIT are their own families

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: the builder wrote a logo_reference constraint that the verifier did not check, so a model-guessed logo passed the brand-token gate
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: logo_reference is a verified brand token

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: source_id reaches into a filename, so a crafted id could write outside the nominated workdir, and nothing stopped the render from overwriting its own source
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: assert_contained on the target and a refusal to overwrite the source

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: narration, music and effects clips were reported as flattened media, telling an editor not to look for controls that are present
